name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the hint. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the hint. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire hint component in a `call` block.

name: id
description: The `id` attribute to add to the hint.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the hint.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the hint.
